title: ZuckOff Is a Free App That Sees Meta Glasses Before They See You
summary: ZuckOff is a free mobile app that uses computer vision and AI to detect when people are wearing Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses with built-in cameras, addressing growing privacy concerns about surreptitious recording.
problem_solved: Addresses privacy concerns by alerting users when someone nearby is wearing Meta smart glasses capable of secretly recording them.
why_valuable: Empowers individuals to protect their privacy in public spaces where wearable cameras pose surveillance risks, democratizing access to counter-surveillance tools.
